title: What can we do at December Nights?
description:
We are counting down the hours to December Nights! The City's largest free holiday festival is Friday, Dec. 5 from 3 –11 p.m. and Saturday, Dec. 6 from 11 a.m. - 11 p.m. at Balboa Park. ⛄

There's so much to do! Meet Santa, watch half-pipe skateboarding demos, and enjoy cozy sips & bites at our new holiday cocktail garden, Après Tavern.🍷 

Visit decembernights.org for more information on transportation, entertainment schedules and vendors. 

#decembernights #sandiego
